column1: # The CLI's tests that need a browser are run in CI one at a time, in the runner's Chrome (coverage.yml, ci.yml),
# all but these. Each line: the test's exact name, a tab, why it fails there. Measured 22 Nov 2026 on staging 62556a36
# (CI run 45031506648; upstream v0.43.0 and this fork side by side in Chrome 157). A line goes when its test passes
# again: "fork" ones when the fork's own tests cover what they hold, "upstream" ones when an upstream release fixes them (UNB-208).
